Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.model.state.special

Class PreviousState

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.model.state.special.PreviousState
public final class PreviousState extends Object
Marker class for transitions that should return to the previous (hidden) state.

This class is used with @OutgoingTransition(activate = {PreviousState.class}) to indicate a dynamic transition that returns to whatever state was covered by an overlay.

When a state overlays another (e.g., a menu opens over a game screen), the covered state is tracked as "hidden". Transitions to PreviousState will dynamically resolve to return to that hidden state.

Example usage: 


 @OutgoingTransition(
     activate = {PreviousState.class},
     pathCost = 0,  // Override default of 1 for free transitions
     description = "Close menu and return to previous state"
 )
 public boolean closeMenu() {
     return action.click(closeButton).isSuccess();
 }

This enables flexible navigation where overlay states (menus, dialogs, popups) can be closed to return to whatever state they were covering, without hardcoding specific target states.

Since:
1.0
